title: DevOps adoption: challenges from the trenches
description:
DevOps adoption is not only about tools. This interactive Table Talk explores real-world lessons on technical blockers, cultural resistance, and hidden complexity that emerges when teams adopt DevOps practices. We will compare practical patterns, common mistakes, and how platform engineering and AI are influencing the next stage of DevOps, so attendees leave with useful ideas for their own organizations.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
